version: Phase IV frozen typed identification architecture

conventions.intrinsic_scc_rule: Only unconditional identification iff edges; retain every candidate signature. Canonical selection, transport and conditional edges do not supply intrinsic inverses.
conventions.iff_semantics: Two verified round trips on the declared candidate class; categorical comparisons retain the context.
conventions.conditional_edge_semantics: Source and every required_nodes entry are simultaneous inputs; the inverse retains the context.
conventions.germ_policy: Formal nodes give germs. Arbitrary global candidate identification retains connected real analyticity; the canonical global representative is explicitly constructed.
conventions.root_minimality: One intrinsic certificate, optional placement, requested external selection packets; no absolute encoding minimum.
